Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 18, "heading": "I\nLES BONNES ÂMES", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u018-b0030", "target": "— Господин протонотарий, — спросила Гошер, — что вы предскажете об этом мнимом подкидыше?", "source_sha256": "71c81d8a7e202834ff1c747f03b1982aaebe3b57378e65b5fa435632b36ce63c", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u018-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "c9986ec468eb889bdc0386f6551e2ed895198753076cba757d3f0c7d3e0b47dc"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u018-b0031", "target": "— Величайшие бедствия, — ответил Мистриколь.", "source_sha256": "bf24ebf33064df948c7f2f123256bbb3534e7fb7b5afa9b3e65173624b2bef6c", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u018-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4ec0654cd5a8a93ac873e10905aa521c1711f83a828a815449e64b6f50d15d0c"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 4, "chapter": 1, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u018-b0032", "text": "—Ah! mon Dieu! dit une vieille dans l'auditoire, avec cela qu'il y a eu une considérable pestilence l'an passé et qu'on dit que les Anglais vont débarquer en compagnie à Harefleu.", "sha256": "f4e6f738744a106fd379e9e20add0202f1142727a2afec9bc32f32c7d2b90b87", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1045], "source_xml_sha256": "a45384609c93cd857383d945a0cc473fe3fc999bc00e3c800c424ac456bd09db", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0033", "text": "—Cela empêchera peut-être la reine de venir à Paris au mois de septembre, reprit une autre. La marchandise va déjà si mal!", "sha256": "a3052772ab7daaee13048f8d6e9aa1f06bd6ff65f72f7a8d20706f0749a3623b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1046], "source_xml_sha256": "f247555f2e0183c350af45a010d8768c7f4a6fe8559799a737a2aff453e7a03c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0034", "text": "—Je suis d'avis, s'écria Jehanne de la Tarme, qu'il vaudrait mieux pour les manants de Paris que ce petit magicien-là fût couché sur un fagot que sur une planche.", "sha256": "60681b5d2bb954b351d0c61093f5dcce3ea716d5ba1d51aacda6cda45b4456fd", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1047], "source_xml_sha256": "fec410f20c2ff1efb085ef5d4dbcbba4b90d56f241826b39f31ade85e68e9133", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0035", "text": "—Un beau fagot flambant! ajouta la vieille.", "sha256": "e6c02c7bad47d770b5095f59da06d73f9d7d228d31e42aced849cfec1ce56d5f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1048], "source_xml_sha256": "822077d2f0f20ebdbd00608fc6c467785f99422c909647f332441fa0d06b9ce0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0036", "text": "—Cela serait plus prudent», dit Mistricolle.", "sha256": "655999202a20cb3fadb4f44662ccacc51ac5b6a604497f65055bcb403edb8e63", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1049], "source_xml_sha256": "5e7abee36267b7313d0c9db345d54ee14e4d2d04af49fe40ee56c41904ee8ff9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0037", "text": "Depuis quelques moments un jeune prêtre écoutait le raisonnement des haudriettes et les sentences du protonotaire. C'était une figure sévère, un front large, un regard profond. Il écarta silencieusement la foule, examina le [[I]]petit magicien[[/I]], et étendit la main sur lui. Il était temps. Car toutes les dévotes se léchaient déjà les barbes du [[I]]beau fagot flambant[[/I]].", "sha256": "53956deaff927e9d728f169900d664c4a5964abd7dc66e6c337d2e38206cb060", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1050], "source_xml_sha256": "9df79cac607b49498d6866113a3ba8c3767e994888fa3bd00390b63f143081cb", "emphasis_spans": 2, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0038", "text": "«J'adopte cet enfant», dit le prêtre.", "sha256": "4eec6e9a3d151a6ca20f6507337df90e448083bd80a53c7b8eae4b6408cbc263", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1051], "source_xml_sha256": "9c8bfce20d964e6709003aad555565abc5551d53798c0629494da0f6b1224510", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0039", "text": "Il le prit dans sa soutane, et l'emporta. L'assistance le suivit d'un œil effaré. Un moment après, il avait disparu par la Porte-Rouge qui conduisait alors de l'église au cloître.", "sha256": "01bbe04a13d49c8dcdbc4ba3ff77cbeca40c95fa8dbf0ad11122f5f7990b39cc", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1052], "source_xml_sha256": "0c4b14b7ca3aac74804b91ab4eb032fb9991ff5da92aec83a6d62f233d377c9a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0040", "text": "Quand la première surprise fut passée, Jehanne de la Tarme se pencha à l'oreille de la Gaultière:", "sha256": "5a4a92560d0ab69665b6a748d83076d1e38fcf07901e39101ffd60ef5109562f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1053], "source_xml_sha256": "3409e132db21e5a84386e5884eb2f5534a6a6cca43acc5f4971d47e6f7a6b1d6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u018-b0041", "text": "«Je vous avais bien dit, ma sœur, que ce jeune clerc monsieur Claude Frollo est un sorcier.»", "sha256": "a3ccc65b016d964c0f3b444aec485b9e4ba787dbfe9eccbd3183f5883c9db33c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1054], "source_xml_sha256": "9b8259ee91c3f39a85d63bdc4d082c27f06173c41fa45f54ff65312841a7221c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
